entities.summary: Elliot S. Maggin, also spelled Elliot S! Maggin, is an American writer of comic books, film, television, and novels. He was a main writer for DC Comics during the Bronze and early Modern ages of comics in the 1970s and 1980s. He is particularly associated with the character of Superman. Maggin was a authors & novelists from United States (b. 1950). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
